_README: ONE static, portable definition per token. Identical everywhere the token
appears, with no per-window or context-specific variants, by design.
PROVENANCE: tier, stream, technology-tag, dossier and milestone definitions
are taken from the generated windows' own legend copy (STREAMS_LEGEND, the
tlegend tgrid, and the .note line in silicon_altar_generator.py).
Lane definitions come from two repo sources. The eleven lanes named in the
windows' own .note execution-order line pair that word with the column
header. The remaining three (innovation, sovereign, corporate) take their
meaning from Silicon_Altar_SCHEMA_v2_2_Delta.md Delta 1 (SCHEMA A.9), which
states a controlled-vocabulary meaning for each lane token. For innovation
that entry is filed under the token 'technology'; Silicon_Altar_Known_Bugs.md
KB-10-01 records this as documentation drift for the same lane and names the
generator LANES table as source of truth.
No lane is currently marked pending. The 'pending' flag remains supported:
set "pending": true and leave definition empty and the popover says so
Keys: tier:A-E | stream:S1-S4 | tag:T1-T13,CM,CTX | lane:<data key> |

tier:A.label: Tier A
tier:A.note: Tier records the standing of the claim, not the quality of the document behind it.

tier:B.label: Tier B
tier:B.definition: Strong secondary consensus with primary underpinnings.
tier:B.note: Tier records the standing of the claim, not the quality of the document behind it.

tier:C.label: Tier C
tier:C.definition: Reasonable inference, with the inferential step named.
tier:C.note: A C is not a weak claim — it is a differently-warranted one.

tier:D.label: Tier D
tier:D.definition: Synthesis and pattern recognition; a project contribution.
tier:D.note: Tier records the standing of the claim, not the quality of the document behind it.

tier:E.label: Tier E
tier:E.note: Tier records the standing of the claim, not the quality of the document behind it.

tag:CM.label: CM
tag:CM.definition: Counter-move — an act of resistance, refusal, or assertion against the operation.

tag:CTX.label: CTX
tag:CTX.definition: Context — background an event needs to be read correctly, not itself a mechanism.

_tagNote: Tags mark which reclassification mechanism an event uses. Most events carry two to four; the operation works by synchronized deployment.

lane:catastrophe.label: Catastrophe
lane:catastrophe.definition: Shock. The disruption that opens the window for everything downstream.

lane:violence.label: Violence & Clearing
lane:violence.definition: Clearing. Removal of people from land and standing.

lane:population.label: Population Processing
lane:population.definition: Sorting. Classification and movement of people as populations.

lane:legal.label: Legal Framework
lane:legal.definition: Legalization. Statute, charter, and ruling that make the prior columns lawful.

lane:land.label: Land Transfer
lane:land.definition: Title. Movement of land from one holder to another.

lane:financial.label: Financial Architecture
lane:financial.definition: Extraction. The instruments that convert the operation into revenue.

lane:records.label: Records / Archives
lane:records.definition: Erasure. Creation, alteration, and destruction of the record itself.

lane:certification.label: Certification Events
lane:certification.definition: Certification. The moment a status is issued and made official.

lane:information.label: Information Architecture
lane:information.definition: Narrative. How the operation is reported, framed, and remembered.

lane:counter-move.label: Counter-Move / Allodial
lane:counter-move.definition: Counter-move. Resistance, refusal, and assertions of allodial standing.

lane:innovation.label: Innovation / Resource
lane:innovation.definition: Installation. Technology and infrastructure laid in, protocols locked down, and the patents and material resources they run on.

lane:sovereign.label: Sovereign Act
lane:sovereign.definition: Standing. Declarations of sovereign standing, treaties entered as sovereign acts, and resolutions of sovereign bodies.

lane:corporate.label: Corporate / Charter
lane:corporate.definition: Charter. Joint-stock formation, franchise grant, and the corporate governance of the entity the operation is contracted through.

dossier.label: DOSSIER
dossier.definition: Opens the evidence behind this row: the sources, their tiers, and the reasoning — including hypotheses the corpus holds rather than asserts.
dossier.note: Not every row has one. Rows without a dossier still carry a tier.

milestone.label: ◆ Milestone
milestone.definition: Marks an event the corpus treats as a turning point in the sequence, not merely an entry within it.
